item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 27/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will continue to bring fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be cold and very dry over the region. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream midweek this week, it will be windy and become cloudier gradually over the coast of Guangdong. However, it will remain cool in the morning and at night. The easterly airstream will moderate over the weekend. It will be relatively humid over the coastal areas. It will be mild during the day. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over southern China are expected to fall again early next week.

Date/Month: 28/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Mainly fine and very dry. Cold in the morning.
Temp range: 11 - 18 C
R.H. range: 25 - 55 per Cent
PSR: Low
